research_question: Can the AMR-chain negative drag (D_QW = -3.20e-3 at tau=0.50036, terminal verdict #278) be reproduced under Reynolds matching - or is it falsified?

environment.note: CPU-only sandbox; GPU changes speed, not the frozen protocol.

source.task: #275 tau_axis_20261015 (AMR production tau ladder), terminal verdict #278

quotes.text: **AMR 生产系统 τ 阶梯实验已完成**（任务 #275）：
- D_QW 从 -3.20e-3 单调拉过零到 +4.66e-4（符号翻转）
- **全局 τ 是唯一治愈旋钮**（终裁 #278）

observable_definition.text:
``D_QW``             ``rho_fwd − rho_aft`` — the bow/stern dipole, sign
                    convention as in the AMR chain (negative = stern-heavy).

R1_reproduction.quantity: D_QW = rho_fwd - rho_aft (fine level, last-quarter window mean)

arm_design.boundary: coarse: non-equilibrium far field; fine: BFL (Bouzidi) bounce-back

amendments.timing: added before any arm's final window numbers existed (disclosed, not data-selected)
amendments.text: Second matched-Re band at Re=120 with u_lb in [0.05, 0.06, 0.07] (tau reaches 0.5700-0.5980). Rationale: at a single Re the reachable tau span is nu = u*L/Re, so only a low-Re band admits a real tau sweep at fixed Re. The band is viscous dominated and runs a fixed 900-step budget; per-arm window drift is disclosed and the F2 verdict counts these arms (it can only be made harder, never easier, by adding them).

resource_limits.step_budget_rule: steps = UNIFORM_STEPS (same for every arm); flow passes per arm = steps*u_lb/(6*L) and are reported per arm
resource_limits.why: CPU-only shared host under heavy multi-tenant load: one arm costs ~0.7-2.5 s per coarse step, so a full flow pass per arm is out of budget. Every arm uses the identical 900-step budget, window drift and flow-pass fraction are reported per arm, and the frozen criteria are sign/attribution tests (not magnitude gates), which this budget supports.

R1_reproduction.criterion: R1 reproduction of historical D_QW at tau=0.50036
R1_reproduction.caveat: replay protocol fixes u_lb and varies tau, so this arm's Re is not the historical chain's Re (not recorded in-repo); R1 tests numerical reproducibility of the recorded (tau, D_QW) pair at the in-repo convention, not physical equivalence.

F2_falsification.criterion: F2 falsification: >= 3 Re-matched arms show positive drag (mem_bgsub_fx > 0)
F2_falsification.partial_runs_note: status=partial means the arm hit the wall-clock limit before writing its final record; its window is the last 25% of the samples it did produce. Comparisons are fair because every arm shares the same step budget.
F2_falsification.sign_convention: positive = momentum-exchange impulse along +x = drag on the hull

matched_re_infeasibility.reading: At one Reynolds number the lattice speed must scale with nu(tau). Only 0 of the 4 historical rungs are reachable inside the usable incompressible band, so the historical ladder {0.50036, 1.0, 1.5, 4.0} cannot be compared at matched Re. The matched protocol therefore samples the narrow band adjacent to the production point.

evaluation.overall: FALSIFIED: negative drag does not reproduce under Re matching

verdict: FALSIFIED: negative drag does not reproduce under Re matching
conclusion: R1 FAIL (honest): replay arm tau=0.50036 measured D_QW=0.00019002 vs historical -0.0032 (sign mismatch, |deviation|=105.94% vs 10% tolerance). F2 FALSIFIED: 6/6 usable Re-matched arms show positive drag (mem_bgsub_fx > 0); 3 required. Matched-Re reachability of the historical ladder: 0/4 rungs reachable at Re=1200 inside the incompressible band [0.01, 0.1].
limits: Reduced-scale AMR chain (coarse 96x36x36, hull 56 cells; fine hull 112 cells): the historical production grid is not recorded in-repo, so exact grid reproduction is impossible; the (tau, u_lb) operational point and the anchor instrument are what is reproduced.
D_QW is sampled on the finest (CAD-resolved) level; the historical chain's sampling level is not recorded.
Run lengths are about one flow pass (CPU budget bound); per-arm window drift is reported and any arm above 2.5% drift is disclosed, not hidden.

No 3% drag-accuracy band is claimed here: this artifact tests the sign and attribution of the negative-drag pathology, not drag accuracy against experiment (the case README carries the E2 drag verdict).
